system.description:
Your mind refuses to remain where another power attempts to place it.
You gain Advantage on saving throws against effects that would inflict the Stunned condition.
Once per day, when you would gain Stunned, reduce the value of Stunned gained by 1, to a minimum of 0.

Prerequisites Chaos-Blooded, Level 5

Works automatically: advantage on saves against Stunned effects is offered with the book's wording; Use spends the day's reduction of one Stunned gained.

conditionals.label: Unbound Impulse
conditionals.scope: Saving throws against effects that would inflict the Stunned condition
